# SpecializedRx

> SpecializedRx is an FDA-registered compounding pharmacy supplier offering innovative pharmaceutical excipients, bases, and specialized equipment for professional pharmacists.

SpecializedRx specializes in premium compounding pharmacy products including transdermal creams, capsule systems, suppository molds, and rapid-dissolve tablets. Their product portfolio combines proprietary formulations with advanced delivery technologies to support custom pharmaceutical compounding.

## Key Topics

- PentraCream™ Anhydrous
- NaturalliSweet™
- HelixGel™
- Topi-CLICK®
- Gelline™ Plasticized
- BITTER-BLOC™
- RocketMolds™
- X-TABB® Mini RDT
- Feton Capsule Filling Machines
- compounding pharmacy
- pharmaceutical bases
- transdermal delivery
- pharmacy excipients
- rapid-dissolve tablets
- capsule products
